sxablono.name: filtrilo
sxablono.description: A filter bar over a list: the landmark search with its name, its fields in a row that wraps, its actions and a status line with the count of hits, heard politely.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the landmark search: what the filters filter (Standards filtern).

regions.name: fields
regions.description: The filters, each a field with its visible label, in a row that wraps.

regions.name: actions
regions.description: Actions on the filters, such as resetting them.

regions.name: status
regions.description: The count of hits (3 von 7 Standards), a polite live region: the effect of a filter is heard while the focus stays in the field.

goals.kialo: Filters over a list are one pattern, because they are the landmark search of the page, wrap as one row and say the count of hits without moving the focus.
